problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 3 delivery routes through 3 distribution hubs.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling procedures represented as (Hub, Duration) pairs,
where each pair specifies the hub where the procedure must occur and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which procedures must be completed.

Route details:
* Route A requires the sequence: (Hub2, 5) → (Hub3, 9) → (Hub1, 8)
* Route B requires the sequence: (Hub2, 6) → (Hub3, 10) → (Hub1, 4)
* Route C requires the sequence: (Hub3, 3) → (Hub1, 2) → (Hub2, 10)

Each handling procedure must run without interruption once it begins,
and each hub can only handle one procedure at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all procedures at the hubs
so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
